Focused synthetic investigation adapter failure test measured timeout and malformed JSON separately (2/2 PASS); each records operation/correlation/cause and continues all later runners. External live AI service was not used.

Controller fallback instrumentation plan names the existing provider file and exact correlation logging work; fallback handoff preserves null source_run_id, limitation and next action. Actual reviewer agent revision path is not covered here.

A spawned child writes a content-bearing planning handoff for the fixed synthetic identity, persists a begin event, and exits via os._exit(19), bypassing finally. The handoff artifact is read back before reconciliation; reconciliation adds an interruption event; a provider run with the same job/launch/date/null-run then calls every stage (PASS). An additional synthetic SQLite test creates exactly one matching job/manifest and a running report attempt, then a spawned process writes report.html and exits before attempt terminal/output registration. Reopening the store and continuing the same job marks the old attempt interrupted without adding output metadata, starts attempt_no+1, completes it, and leaves no running orphan (PASS). Existing completed-job report-only resume and terminal-attempt closure nodes pass. No production DB, real reporter/reviewer, or public remote is used. Additional FC08-F1 process crash after report remote publication and sidecar but before reconciliation passes: synthetic SQLite job stays nonterminal through child exit; same identity resumes; all stage records/artifacts and public remote content are read back; only reconciliation finalizes. Incident remains in_progress. Missing handoff and missing public report readback do not finalize complete. This is local synthetic evidence, not the production job.
